name: Preserve nonvisual game discovery when removing midway navigation
instruction: A change that removes or hides the midway's named game links also provides an equivalent keyboard- and screen-reader-operable way to discover every registered game and open a chosen one.
relevant_when: A diff in src/main.ts or src/style.css removes, hides, or disables the midway's list of links or buttons for registered games.
context: Tessl Review found in PR #8 that removing the Booths navigation left only an unlabeled canvas route and a booth card that appears after visual movement. The replacement must preserve both discovery and activation without requiring visual map navigation.
scope_reason: The patch shows the removed game navigation and any replacement semantic controls introduced by the same change.

checklist.name: nonvisual-discovery-and-entry
checklist.rule: If named links or buttons for registered games are removed or hidden, the diff adds an alternative that lets a keyboard or screen-reader user learn each available game's name and activate a chosen game without navigating the canvas visually. A generic canvas aria-label or proximity-only booth card does not satisfy this.
